task_id.description: Existing generation-plan ID returned by seenical.plan.list.

tools.title: 查看内容服务用量
tools.description: Read current Seenical content-generation usage and limits.

tools.title: 查看生成计划
tools.description: List content-generation plans and their current configuration. Keep fields distinct: name is the plan name, prompt is the plan topic, article_prompt is the per-article instruction, keywords is the newline-separated article-title pool, and note is legacy descriptive text. For an article-prompt question use only article_prompt; never substitute prompt or note. Read this list before selecting a task_id or changing the title pool.

tools.title: 创建生成计划
tools.description: Create a plan without running it. name, prompt and chatbot_id identify the plan, content theme and Agent; omitted optional fields use Seenical defaults.

prompt.description: Plan topic (计划主题): the continuing content subject, maximum 20000 characters. This is not the article prompt.

chatbot_id.description: Existing Agent ID used to generate content.

note.description: Optional descriptive/legacy plan text; defaults to prompt. This is not the article prompt.

article_prompt.description: Article prompt (文章提示词): extra instruction applied to every generated article, maximum 5000 characters. Empty string means no article prompt is configured and explicitly clears it.

article_language.description: Article language: auto, Simplified Chinese or English.

keywords.description: Article-title pool (legacy API field name: keywords), with exactly one complete title per line. This is not an SEO keyword list or an article prompt. Empty string means no article titles.

word_count_min.description: Minimum words per article, zero or greater.

word_count_max.description: Maximum words, not less than word_count_min.

image_count.description: Images per article, zero or greater.

article_count.description: Articles generated per recurring run, from 1 to 100000. For cycle_type=none, a run consumes all available unused titles instead.

cycle_type.description: none for no recurring schedule, cycle for recurring.

title_reuse.description: Whether later runs may reuse titles after reaching the end of the title pool. This also applies when a non-recurring plan is run manually again.

site_id_list.description: Target site IDs; [] means no site binding.

target_summary_dir.description: Optional GitBook navigation/SUMMARY directory. Empty or omitted means the same directory as target_dir.

run_immediately.description: Must be false; running is a separate confirmed operation.

tools.title: 修改生成计划
tools.description: Partially update a plan. Send task_id and only user-requested fields; omitted fields and pause state remain unchanged. To add or remove article titles, first read the current plan, then replace keywords with the complete newline-separated title pool. Never store a requested title in name, prompt or article_prompt.

note.description: Descriptive/legacy plan text, not the article prompt; empty string clears it.

chatbot_id.description: Existing Agent ID used for future generations.

prompt.description: Plan topic (计划主题), not the article prompt; maximum 20000 characters.

article_prompt.description: Article prompt (文章提示词): extra instruction applied to every generated article, maximum 5000 characters. Empty string explicitly clears it.

keywords.description: Complete article-title pool (legacy API field name: keywords), with exactly one complete title per line. Updating this field replaces the whole pool, so preserve unmodified titles when adding or removing one. Do not use commas as separators. Empty string clears all article titles.

word_count_max.description: Maximum words, not less than minimum.

image_count.description: Images per article, zero or greater.

article_count.description: Articles generated per recurring run, from 1 to 100000. It does not limit a cycle_type=none run, which consumes all available unused titles.

cycle_type.description: Schedule type; this does not resume a paused plan.

title_reuse.description: Whether later runs may reuse titles after reaching the end of the title pool. This also applies when a non-recurring plan is run manually again.

target_summary_dir.description: GitBook navigation/SUMMARY directory. Empty string means the same directory as target_dir.

embedding_condition.description: Knowledge retrieval filter expression; {} clears custom filtering.

tools.title: 暂停或恢复计划
tools.description: Set only a plan's schedule state. schedule=off pauses and schedule=on resumes; no other plan field changes.

schedule.description: on resumes scheduling; off pauses it.

tools.title: 立即运行计划
tools.description: Start one generation run for an existing plan; this is separate from creating or editing the plan. Read the current plan first and verify that it has at least one article title in keywords or an existing uploaded title file in file_list. If neither source exists, add titles through keywords or direct the user to Console file upload before running.

tools.title: 查看计划运行记录
tools.description: List generation runs for one plan.

tools.title: 查看生成结果
tools.description: List generated article/file results for one run.

tools.title: 重试生成任务
tools.description: Retry a failed generation run after reading its status.

tools.title: 创建内容预览
tools.description: Create a publishable preview from one completed generation run.

tools.title: 重试内容预览
tools.description: Retry preparation of one failed preview.

tools.title: 发布内容预览
tools.description: Publish an approved preview. This changes the live site and always requires strong confirmation.

tools.title: 丢弃内容预览
tools.description: Discard an unpublished preview without deleting the generation run. Always requires strong confirmation.

tools.title: 部署生成结果
tools.description: Deploy one completed generation run according to its configured site target. Read plan and run state before execution.
